title: Plugin-foundation routing rules
description: One govern-now CLI plugin's routing-rules.json: the ordered list of operations it forces Claude toward its CLI for. Read by two independent consumers that must never disagree: BuildRegistry (Go) turns it into the adoption library's registry for CI-time adoption measurement, and forced-use-hook.sh applies the identical CLI-before-raw precedence live, in-session. Authoring one file instead of two keeps the live decision and the measured decision from drifting apart.

operations.description: Governed operations in match precedence order: for a given invocation, the first operation whose CLI or raw route matches wins. Two operations should not declare overlapping raw or CLI patterns; nothing enforces that today beyond order.

name.description: Operation identifier, carried through to every adoption.Classification and adoption.CLIAdoption this operation produces. Unique within the document.

invocation_prefix.description: Bash command prefix that marks an invocation as using this operation's CLI: the command equals this string, or starts with it followed by a space. Never a glob or regex.

bin_name.description: Governed CLI's executable name. forced-use-hook.sh falls back to `command -v` on this name when bin_env is unset or does not resolve to an executable file.

bin_env.description: Environment variable download-script.sh exports the verified, checksummed binary's absolute path under. Omit when the operation has no such variable — forced-use-hook.sh then relies on bin_name alone.

usage_hint.description: Exact invocation forced-use-hook.sh's deny-and-redirect message names.

tool_name.description: Claude Code tool name a raw invocation used (e.g. "Bash", "Read").

command_prefixes.description: When tool_name is "Bash", the command prefixes (same matching rule as cli.invocation_prefix) that count as a raw invocation of this operation. Omit or leave empty to match every Bash invocation regardless of command text — the only sensible shape for a non-Bash raw route.
